main_body: Two stacked props: a tall brown crate/barrel with a diagonal strap on the right, and a banded barrel on the left. A pale sack sits partly behind them on the right.
top_band: At the top of the tall body (rows 0-3) there is a mid-brown cap with a 1-row lighter orange patch at about row 1. Nothing reads as a lighter horizontal surface. The left barrel's top (rows 3-6) is a thin brown rim the same tone as its face.
evidence: The tall body is drawn straight on from the front. The only top is a 1-2 row cap that is the same tone as the face, and the strap and bands are painted flat on it. The left barrel has no elliptical lid or opening and only a thin rim above its bands. Neither volume has a top band, a front-edge line or an eave shadow, so this reads as a front elevation, or rim only.

style.evidence: The brown ramp has about 4 steps with a dark-brown outline, which is a tinted material tone and not black. The broad body areas (the large front panel of the tall crate and the lower barrel) are mostly flat fills with little grain. The pale sack is a large flat cream area with only minimal shading. Compared with the Beodeul stall and well references, the tiles carry fewer colours, so the piece looks thinner.
